fields.v: Each configuration judged on its own values; quality and cost verdicts for every entry: no criterion stated by the authors (the study sets no thresholds). Routing (75 core queries, Hit@1 Easy/Hard average, all-field input unless stated; success criterion: SkillsBench expert labels; cost = online serving, reported only for four systems, Table 20; not reported for the others). Encoder-only (Table 3): BM25 .314; BGE-Large-v1.5 .600; gemini-embedding-001 .587; text-embedding-3-large .620; Qwen3-Emb-0.6B .560; Qwen3-Emb-8B .640 (p50 60.4 ms, 22,539 MiB); SR-Emb-0.6B .653 (p50 19.8 ms, 9,364 MiB); SR-Emb-8B .680. Retrieve-and-rerank, top-20 (Table 4): Qwen3-Emb-0.6B x Qwen3-Rank-0.6B .640; Qwen3-Emb-8B x Qwen3-Rank-0.6B .580; Qwen3-Emb-8B x Qwen3-Rank-8B (16B, strongest base) .680 (p50 2,900.1 ms, 22,539 MiB); SR-Emb-0.6B x Qwen3-Rank-0.6B .707; SR-Emb-0.6B x Qwen3-Rank-8B .714; SkillRouter 1.2B (SR-Emb-0.6B x SR-Rank-0.6B) .740, R@10 .704 (p50 495.8 ms, 18,976 MiB); SR-Emb-8B x SR-Rank-8B (scaling) .760; LLM-as-judge rerankers on the same lists: GPT-4o-mini .673, GPT-5.4-mini .660.
